members.placeholdersHint: People from an imported tracker. They can't sign in and take no seat.
members.mergeConfirm: Everything {{name}} did moves to the person you pick, and {{name}} is removed. This can't be undone.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Each import stays connected until you finish the migration: run it again or let it sync hourly. Kupro only reads from the source, and edits made in Kupro win.
imports.none: No imports yet. Bring your work over from another tracker, a CSV file or another Kupro workspace.
imports.emptyPrompt: Coming from Jira or Azure DevOps?

snapshot.sub: From kupro import --local or a script

importWizard.ready: Ready. This is exactly what the import writes.

blocked.source: Pick a source and fill in how to reach it, or choose a file.
blocked.fold: Pick one of the two options to continue. There is no default.
blocked.effort: Enter hours per story point, or import those items without effort.
blocked.projectKeys: Key {{keys}} is taken. Pick another key or import into that project.
blocked.projectsMissing: Project {{keys}} no longer exists. Pick another one.

importWizard.sourceLede: Pick a source and connect. The next steps map it, with a live dry run on the right.
importWizard.emailHint: Jira Cloud: the email of the account the API token belongs to. Data Center: leave empty and paste a personal access token.
importWizard.tokenHint: Read access is enough. Kupro encrypts it and deletes it when you finish the migration.
importWizard.behindVpn: Behind a VPN or firewall: run kupro import {{kind}} --local and upload the snapshot.
importWizard.trelloAuthorizeHint: Allow read access, then paste the token Trello shows. Once you finish the migration, you can revoke it in Trello.
importWizard.trelloNoKey: This server isn't set up to read Trello. Run kupro import trello --local and upload the snapshot.

drop.kupro: Drop a Kupro export .zip here or

dropHint.csv: You check its columns before the next step.
dropHint.snapshot: Made by kupro import … --local or your own script.
dropHint.kupro: Moves a whole workspace, keys and history included.

importWizard.noSource: This import reads its source with a token. Start a new import to change it.
importWizard.connectedLede: Connected. Changing the source starts a new import; this one stays as a draft.
importWizard.projectsLede: Pick what to import and the key each project gets. Item numbers stay where the source has them.
importWizard.boardLabel: Status, sprints and estimates from a GitHub project
importWizard.boardHint: Its Status sets the state of open issues, its Iteration becomes sprints, and a number field such as Estimate, Points or Size becomes the estimate. A project on a personal account needs a classic token with read:project.
importWizard.hierarchyLede: The source has four levels, Kupro has three. This is a team choice with no default.
importWizard.foldLegend: Which end folds? The counts cover every project in the import.
importWizard.treePick: Pick an option above to see where these items land.
importWizard.treeLegend: Real items from the source. A highlighted note marks a new parent or type; a moved item keeps a relates link to its old parent. Hover or focus an item to find it on the other side.
importWizard.typesLede: Each source type becomes a Kupro type, or is left out. A label keeps where it came from.
importWizard.statesLede: Mapped by each state's category where the source has one. Change any row; the plan on the right updates.
importWizard.peopleLede: Matched by email first, then by name. Check the name matches; placeholders can be invited later.
importWizard.fieldsLede: Pick which fields become labels. The rest go into a details block on each issue.
importWizard.noFields: This source has no fields to map.
importWizard.effortLede: Estimates in hours come across as they are. Story points have no safe conversion, so you choose.
importWizard.hoursHint: No default: every team sizes points differently.
importWizard.noEffort: Import items with only story points without effort
importWizard.reviewLede: The dry run. Nothing is written until you import, and the import can be undone until you finish the migration.
importWizard.perPointNotSet: Hours per story point not set
importWizard.hoursAsIs: Hours from the file, as they are

warn.statusesToReview_one: {{count}} item has a state Kupro guessed. Check it under States.
warn.statusesToReview_other: {{count}} items have a state Kupro guessed. Check them under States.
warn.keysTaken_one: {{count}} item gets the next free number and keeps its key as an alias.
warn.keysTaken_other: {{count}} items get the next free number and keep their key as an alias.
warn.conflicts_one: {{count}} field changed on both sides. Kupro keeps its value.
warn.conflicts_other: {{count}} fields changed on both sides. Kupro keeps its values.
warn.deletedInSource_one: {{count}} imported item is gone from the source. It is left alone.
warn.deletedInSource_other: {{count}} imported items are gone from the source. They are left alone.
warn.parentLoops_one: {{count}} item is in a parent loop and becomes a top-level issue.
warn.parentLoops_other: {{count}} items are in a parent loop and become top-level issues.
warn.skippedByScope_one: {{count}} item is left out by the scope.
warn.skippedByScope_other: {{count}} items are left out by the scope.

importWizard.noWarnings: Nothing to look at: every item has a place.
importWizard.alsoCopied: Also copied: {{comments}} comments, {{changes}} history entries, {{sprints}} sprints, {{labels}} labels.
importWizard.foldBottomTrade: Top-level items stay on the delivery plan. The bottom level's grouping becomes a relates link.
importWizard.foldTopTrade: The lower levels keep their children. Top-level items leave the delivery plan and become labels.

importRail.title: Plan
importRail.lede: Dry run, updates as you map. The last column is the change since your last edit.
importRail.empty: Connect a source to see a live dry run of what Kupro will create.
importRail.first: Reading the source for the first dry run…

decision.projects: Projects: a key or a target needs another look

importRun.title: Importing
importRun.lede: You can close this tab; the run continues on the server.
importRun.queued: Waiting for another run to finish
importRun.failedLede: Everything up to the last finished batch is kept. Fix the cause and try again; the run resumes without duplicates.
importRun.nextText: This import now lives under Imports: its runs, conflicts, placeholders to invite, Undo and Finish.
importRun.autoSync: Sync from {{source}} every hour until you finish the migration
importRun.railNote: Kupro keeps the source link until you finish the migration.

importPage.tokenRejectedText: The source refused the token. Paste a new one; the next run continues where the last one stopped.
importPage.autoSyncHint: Turns itself off after 30 days with no change on either side. You get an email when it does.
importPage.undoConfirm: Undo deletes every issue, project, label and sprint this import created. It can't be undone.
importPage.edited_one: {{n}} imported issue was edited in Kupro since: {{keys}}
importPage.edited_other: {{n}} imported issues were edited in Kupro since: {{keys}}
importPage.blocked_one: Undo is blocked: {{n}} record made outside this import points at its issues ({{list}}).
importPage.blocked_other: Undo is blocked: {{n}} records made outside this import point at its issues ({{list}}).
importPage.finishConfirm: Finishing stops syncing and deletes the token. Keys, aliases and history stay. After this, the import can't be undone.

importRuns.deleted_one: {{count}} item is gone from the source and was left alone:
importRuns.deleted_other: {{count}} items are gone from the source and were left alone:

importConflicts.lede: Someone changed these in Kupro after the last import. Kupro kept its value; the source value is shown so you can decide.
importConflicts.kept: Kept. It comes back only if the source changes again.

importPeople.lede: People an import couldn't match to a member. Invite them, or merge them into a member; their history follows.
